description: Narrator and radio-chatter text to speech with Qwen3-TTS 12Hz 1.7B. Describe a voice and its emotion (VoiceDesign), or clone one from a reference clip of about 3 seconds (Base), then speak your lines. Language is a setting, Auto by default. Writes one mono 24 kHz WAV. Runs the official qwen-tts 0.1.1 with bf16 weights, SDPA attention and full-text (non-streaming) input; loads one 1.7B model per job. Apache-2.0 weights and code.
title: Qwen3-TTS 12Hz 1.7B voice design and cloning single Spark
